LanguageData.RimForex_LevRiskyNote: HIGH RISK: stop-out {0}% < daily move {1}% ({2}x). Likely liquidated within hours.

LanguageData.RimForex_LineCompactTip: Spread cost {0} silver, margin taken {1} silver, fee {2} silver.
LanguageData.RimForex_TestNormalGapTip: In {0} game hours every currency takes one normal gap (8-9x the single-step volatility, random direction). The upper half of the normal range is used so the announcement is guaranteed to fire — otherwise the button can look like it did nothing. A normal gap cannot push a position into negative balance; use the extreme gap button above for that.
LanguageData.RimForex_MsgTestNormalGap: Normal gap scheduled: fires in {0} game hours.
LanguageData.RimForex_TestClearGhostTip: Temporary factions created by quests (boss groups, pilgrims, hacked terminals, etc.) are not real trading partners; currencies under their names were created by an older bug. Daily settlement clears them automatically — this button is for cleaning an old save immediately. Currencies still used by an open position are skipped; close those first.
LanguageData.RimForex_MsgGhostCleared: Cleared {0} ghost currencies ({1} skipped because of open positions).
LanguageData.RimForex_MsgGhostBlocked: {0} ghost currencies are still used by open positions. Close them first — deleting a currency would leave those positions without a market.
LanguageData.RimForex_SettingsGameplayDesc: These three actually change the market and the economy, not just the display.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_QuoteIntervalTip: One quote every {0} ticks, about {1} per game day. Daily volatility is unchanged; only the tick rate moves.\nEach quote is walked in {2} intra-quote steps — that is why the chart keeps moving, and it is expected.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_QuotesPerCandleTip: One candle is about {0} real seconds. Affects chart readability only.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_GapIntensityTip: Normal gaps {0}% per game day; extreme gaps (can cause a blow-up) {1}% per game day.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_GenNamesHint: Press the button to generate 12 sample currency names (with symbols) using each tier's naming rules.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_TrendAmpTip: Lets rates drift into trends spanning many candles. Currently about {0}% swing per half cycle. Higher means livelier but easier to get liquidated. Set to 0 to disable.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_TrendPeriodTip: Time for one full round trip. Half a cycle is about {0} game days of one-way move.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_NameDesc: Currency names are generated deterministically from a global seed plus the faction, using word lists that match the game language.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_RerollNamesTip: Picks a new global seed and immediately writes the new names back to every currency already in the terminal. Rates, charts, positions and trade history are untouched.
LanguageData.RimForex_HistoryClearTip: Erases all {0} trade records. Balance, positions and lifetime fees are unaffected.
LanguageData.RimForex_HistoryClearConfirm: Erase all {0} trade records? This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_ClearDesc: After changing market parameters the chart still mixes in candles made by the old settings, so you cannot see what the new model looks like. Clear them and let it re-accumulate.
LanguageData.RimForex_SettingsHintsDesc: These toggles only show or hide on-screen explanatory text. They do not change any numbers or game rules.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_QuotePacingTip: Shows "one candle every N quotes" and the next-quote countdown above the chart.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_ChartLegendTip: Show a small line under the chart explaining why the entry line is not on the last-price line (the fill price includes half a spread). Turn off once you know it.
LanguageData.RimForex_ChartStopOutTip:
Force-close line for your {0} position, in mid price.

You filled at {1}; if price reaches {2} equity falls to 30% of the margin and the position is liquidated.
Stop-out distance is about {3}% (accounting for any added margin).
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_StopOutLineTip: Draws the red dashed "stop-out" line on the chart, marking the price at which your current position would be force-closed.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_BreakevenLineTip: Draws the blue "break-even" line on the chart. Turn it off when you hold many positions and the chart gets busy.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_SettleCountdownTip: Shows "next settlement in N h" in the account header.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_TimeDebugTip: Prints TicksAbs / current hour / ticks-to-settlement under the countdown, for checking that the conversion is right. Off by default.
LanguageData.RimForex_TimeDebug: TicksAbs {0} · hour {1} · {2} ticks to settlement ({3} h)
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_CostBreakdownTip: When off, the per-line cost details collapse into one compact line with a tooltip.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_FloatingPnlTip: Shows the floating P/L of your open positions in a screen corner while the terminal is closed. Drag it with the left mouse button; the position is remembered.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_TimeSpeedTip: Shows the note next to the embedded time controls at the bottom of the terminal.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_LossMoodScaleHint: Base values: small -5 / medium -7 / big -10 / huge -15. Stacks multiply, so a triple huge loss is -45. Set to 0 to disable loss moods.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_GainMoodScaleHint: Base values: small +3 / medium +5 / big +8 / huge +12. Set to 0 to disable gain moods.
LanguageData.RimForex_Set_MarginCallMoodScaleHint: Base -20, up to -60 when stacked three times. Margin calls are their own tier and ignore the two multipliers above. A blow-up (margin gone and balance pushed negative) is a heavier tier at base -28. It never stacks, and this multiplier controls it too.
LanguageData.RimForex_SettingsVersion: Rimforex {0} · include this line in bug reports
LanguageData.RimForex_SettingsTestDesc: These two buttons exercise paths that normal play rarely reaches. Not meant for everyday use.
LanguageData.RimForex_TestMoodTip: Each press stacks one more small-loss mood on every colonist of the current map (max three). Use it to check stacking and multi-day expiry: a small loss lasts 0.5 days, or 0.75 when fully stacked, so it should be gone after a night's sleep.
LanguageData.RimForex_TestBlowUpTip: In about {0} game hours every currency takes a maximum-size downward gap. Go 100x long first to test a blow-up (balance pushed negative). The gap fires only once.
LanguageData.RimForex_MsgTestMood: Stacked one more "small loss" mood. Press again to test the stacking cap, then sleep a night to see it expire.
LanguageData.RimForex_MsgTestBlowUp: Extreme gap scheduled. It will fire in about {0} game hours.
LanguageData.RimForex_MsgForceGap: The exchange convulses: the interstellar FX platform just took an extreme gap.
LanguageData.RimForex_MsgForceNormalGap: The exchange stirs: the interstellar FX platform just gapped.
LanguageData.RimForex_MsgNoMap: No map is currently open, so that test cannot run.
LanguageData.RimForex_AllInTip: Uses every silver of free margin at the selected leverage. The margin actually taken may be slightly less, because units are whole numbers.
LanguageData.RimForex_ZeroTip: Reset to the smallest margin that can still open 1 unit.
LanguageData.RimForex_NotEnoughMargin: Not enough free margin (margin plus fee exceeds your balance).
